description:
Activate Selvala by tapping it, adding at least two mana of any color
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting Selvala.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Seeker of Skybreak's ability, targeting Seeker of Skybreak.
Resolve both Seeker of Skybreak abilities, untapping it and Selvala.
Repeat.
